# Jay Santoshi Watch

> Jay Santoshi Watch is a watch store and watch & clock repair shop in Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Rated 4.9/5 on Google from 209+ reviews.

## Key facts
- Name: Jay Santoshi Watch (also: Jay Santoshi Watch Co., Jay Santoshi Watch Company, Jai Santoshi Watch)
- Category: Watch store, watch repair shop, clock repair service
- Address: Shop No. 1, Swapna Shilp Complex, Nigam Nagar, Near ONGC, Visat–Sabarmati Highway, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424, India
- Landmark: Near ONGC, Visat–Sabarmati Highway
- Phone: +91 93746 41275 / +91 90991 38100 (WhatsApp: +91 90991 38100)
- Hours: Open daily, 10:30 AM – 9:00 PM (may change on festivals)
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jay+Santoshi+Watch+Chandkheda+Ahmedabad
- Independent shop, not an authorised service centre of any brand.
- Languages: Gujarati, Hindi, English

## Services
- [Watch Repair](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-repair/): Repairs for all common brands of analog, digital and quartz watches: stopped watches, broken crowns, loose hands and more.
- [Watch Battery Replacement](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-battery-replacement/): Fast cell replacement for quartz and digital watches, usually done while you wait.
- [Car Key & Car Remote Battery Replacement](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/car-key-battery-replacement/): Car key and car remote (key fob) battery replacement for all car brands, usually done in minutes.
- [Watch Strap Replacement](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-strap-replacement/): New leather, silicone and resin watch straps in the right width, fitted while you wait.
- [Watch Chain Replacement & Resizing](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-chain-replacement/): New steel, gold-tone and two-tone watch chains in all sizes, plus chain resizing by adding or removing links.
- [Watch Glass Replacement](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-glass-replacement/): Replacement of cracked or scratched watch glass (crystal) for round and many shaped watches.
- [Watch Servicing & Cleaning](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-servicing/): Cleaning, check-up and care for watches that run slow, fast, or haven't been looked after for a long time.
- [Watch & Clock Movement (Machine) Replacement](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-movement-replacement/): A new quartz movement (machine) for wristwatches and wall clocks that no longer work, keeping the original dial and case.
- [Wall Clock & Clock Repair](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/wall-clock-repair/): Repairs for quartz wall clocks, table clocks and alarm clocks, including movement (machine) replacement.
- [Wrist Watches for Men, Women & Kids](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/wrist-watches/): Titan, Sonata, Fastrack, Timex, Maxima and Lamex wristwatches for men, women and kids, for daily wear, office and gifting.
- [Wall Clocks](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/wall-clocks/): Wall clocks for living rooms, bedrooms, offices and shops, plus clocks for housewarming gifts.
- [Straps, Chains & Watch Accessories](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/watch-accessories/): Spare straps, metal chains, buckles, spring bars, watch batteries and other accessories.
- [Smartwatch Straps & Belts](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/smartwatch-straps/): Replacement straps and belts for Apple Watch, Samsung, Noise, boAt, Fire-Boltt, Amazfit and Fastrack Reflex smartwatches.
- [TV & AC Remote Batteries (AA, AAA)](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/remote-batteries/): AA and AAA pencil cells for TV, AC and set-top box remotes, plus coin cells for small remotes.
- [Coin Cell & Button Batteries](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/coin-cell-batteries/): CR2032, CR2025, CR2016, LR44 and other button cells for calculators, glucometers, weighing scales, hearing aids, toys and laser lights.
- [Gift Watches & Clocks](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/services/gift-watches/): Watches and clocks for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, Raksha Bandhan, Diwali and corporate gifting.

## Guides (short answers)
- [How Often Should You Change a Watch Battery?](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/how-often-to-change-watch-battery/): Most quartz watch batteries last about 1.5 to 3 years. Watches with lights, alarms, chronographs or digital displays usually need a new battery sooner. Replace a dead battery quickly, because an old cell can leak and damage the movement.
- [Watch Stopped Working? 7 Common Causes and What to Do](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/watch-stopped-working-what-to-do/): The most common reason a quartz watch stops is a dead battery. Other causes are a crown left pulled out, moisture inside, a damaged movement, or loose hands catching each other. Check the crown first. If the watch still doesn't run, get the battery and movement checked at a watch repair shop.
- [Watch Strap Size Guide: How to Find the Right Width and Fit](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/watch-strap-size-guide/): Strap width is the distance between the watch's lugs, in millimetres. Common sizes are 16, 18, 20 and 22 mm. Pick a strap that matches the lug width exactly. For metal chains, a shop can remove or add links so the watch sits comfortably, with about one finger's space under it.
- [Watch Water Resistance Explained: 30m, 50m, 100m and What They Really Mean](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/watch-water-resistance-explained/): Water-resistance ratings are lab test pressures, not safe diving depths. 30m (3 ATM) means splash-resistant only. 50m (5 ATM) is fine for hand-washing and light rain. 100m (10 ATM) is suitable for swimming. Water resistance weakens with age and after the back is opened, so have the gaskets checked.
- [Quartz vs Automatic Watches: Which Should You Buy?](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/quartz-vs-automatic-watches/): Quartz watches run on a battery, are very accurate, low-maintenance and usually more affordable. Automatic watches are mechanical, wind themselves as you wear them, need no battery, but are less accurate and need periodic servicing. For daily, worry-free use choose quartz. For craftsmanship and character choose automatic.
- [Wall Clock Buying Guide: Size, Style and Silent Clocks](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/wall-clock-buying-guide/): Choose a wall clock by room size and use. Large, bold clocks suit living rooms. Simple, easy-to-read clocks suit kitchens and offices. Silent sweep-movement clocks suit bedrooms and study rooms. Check that the numbers are readable from across the room and that the style matches your decor.
- [Watch Care Tips: 10 Simple Ways to Make Your Watch Last Longer](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/watch-care-tips/): Keep your watch away from heat, water it isn't rated for, magnets and hard knocks. Wipe off sweat after use, keep the crown pushed in, replace dead batteries quickly, and have the watch checked whenever the battery is changed. These simple habits can add years to a watch's life.
- [Watch Gift Ideas for Birthdays, Weddings, Raksha Bandhan and Diwali](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/watch-gift-ideas/): For a watch gift, match the style to the person: classic analog for office wear, sporty digital for students and active people, slim bracelet watches for women, couple watches for weddings and anniversaries, and wall clocks for housewarmings. Set a budget, know their wrist size if possible, and buy from a shop that offers after-sales help.
- [Which Battery Does My Car Key Use? (CR2032, CR2025, CR2016…)](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/which-battery-does-my-car-key-use/): Most car keys and car remotes use a 3V lithium coin cell, usually a CR2032, CR2025, CR2016 or CR1620. The exact code is printed on the old battery inside the key. Common signs of a weak key battery are a shorter remote range, having to press the button several times, and a 'key battery low' warning on the dashboard.
- [Coin Cell Battery Codes Explained: CR2032 vs CR2025 vs LR44](https://www.jaysantoshi.watch/guides/coin-cell-battery-codes-explained/): On lithium coin cells, 'CR' means 3V lithium, the first two digits are the diameter in mm and the last two are the thickness in tenths of a mm. So a CR2032 is 20 mm wide and 3.2 mm thick. LR44-type button cells are 1.5V alkaline, so they can't replace a 3V CR cell. Always match the code on your old battery.
